facts.fact: India Post's savings page gives the PPF rate as 7.1% per annum, compounded yearly
facts.quote: Public Provident Fund Account (PPF) Rate of Interest: 7.1% per annum (compounded yearly)
facts.note: The India Post page shows 'Last Updated On: 19.10.2026' (within Q3 FY 2026-27).

facts.fact: The NSI table shows PPF at 7.1% up to 30.09.2026 (covering Jul-Sep 2026)
Rates for 1 Oct - 31 Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) were set by DEA's Office Memorandum dated 30.09.2026
facts.quote: Revision of interest rates for Small Savings Schemes for Q3 2026-27 30.09.2026

facts.fact: DEA's OM of 30.09.2026 keeps all small savings rates for Oct-Dec 2026 (Q3 FY 2026-27) unchanged from Q2, so PPF stays at 7.1%
facts.note: Quoted from the OCR of the scanned OM. The 7.1% is derived: the OM keeps Q2 rates, and NSI shows PPF at 7.1% to 30.09.2026.
facts.quote: The rates of interest on various Small Savings Schemes for the third quarter of FY 2026-27 starting from 1% October, 2026 and ending on 31° December, 2026 shall remain unchanged from those notified for the second quarter

summary: PPF 7.1% confirmed (India Post current page; NSI to 30.09.2026); DEA Q3 OM dated 30.09.2026 confirmed; 'unchanged' only in the scanned OM (manual).
